entry.headline: Extended — wait for a pullback

entry.action: An unconfirmed turn: a daily low is forming while the bigger picture is still bearish. Nimble traders only — small size, defined stop below 216.6. Not an investment buy until the weekly confirms; most of these fail, a minority start a new cycle.

macro.headline_en: Rate risk runs through its market / growth beta, not a distinct duration leg.
